# GitHub Pull Request #352

## Title
ci: run pi-action on issues and PRs as the pi-action-agent App

## Description
Adds `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`, so `@pi` works on pit's issues and PRs the way it does on cv/pi-action.

The difference from pi-action's dogfood workflow: pi acts as the **pi-action-agent** GitHub App, not with `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Pushes, PRs and tags made with `GITHUB_TOKEN` don't trigger workflows, so a pi-made release PR would never get its required checks (`test (Node 22/24/26)`, `dependency review`), and a pi-pushed tag would never run `release.yml`.

- `actions/create-github-app-token` mints a short-lived installation token (`vars.PI_APP_CLIENT_ID`, `secrets.PI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`), scoped to contents, issues, pull requests and discussions (write) plus actions, checks and statuses (read). The App has no Workflows, Administration, secrets or security-alert access.
- `actions/checkout` uses that token too, so git pushes go out as the App; commits are authored by `pi-action-agent[bot]`. `GITHUB_TOKEN` gets no permissions.
- The job skips any event whose sender is a bot. With an App token pi's own comments and question edits trigger workflows, and one that quotes the trigger phrase would start another run.
- Concurrency is per job, not per workflow, so the runs the `if` skips never take a thread's pending slot from a real one.
- `fetch-depth: 0` for version bumps and release notes; `model_max_tokens: 128000` (Bedrock's maximum for Opus 5.5); pit itself is loaded from the v0.35.0 release, not from the checkout pi edits.

The `main` ruleset is unchanged: the App is not a bypass actor, so its PRs pass CI like anyone's.

Secrets and variables (`NVIDIA_API_KEY`, `PI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`, `PI_APP_CLIENT_ID`) are already set. `actionlint` and `oxfmt --check` pass.

Once merged, a first test: open an issue asking pi to cut v0.35.1 (two Dependabot bumps since v0.35.0).

## Important: Artifact and Script Requirements

**CRITICAL:** After the GitHub Action finishes running, all files modified or created are lost, and the GitHub Action runner is destroyed. Therefore:

1. **All generated code and artifacts MUST be committed** - Any files you create, modify, or generate must be committed and pushed to the repository before the action completes. Nothing will persist otherwise.

2. **Any throw-away scripts generated MUST be run immediately** - If you create temporary scripts (like `/tmp/create-issues.sh` or similar), you must execute them during the same session. They will be lost when the runner terminates.

3. **Commit and push all work** - Always end your work by committing and pushing changes to ensure they persist beyond the GitHub Action execution.

## PR Diff
```diff
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml b/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01ec01a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+name: pi Assistant
+
+on:
+  issues:
+    types: [opened]
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened]
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created, edited] # edited: a box ticked on one of pi's questions
+  pull_request_review_comment:
+    types: [created]
+
+# The job acts with a GitHub App token, which (unlike GITHUB_TOKEN) triggers workflows: CI on pi's PRs,
+# release.yml on its tags. GITHUB_TOKEN itself is not used.
+permissions: {}
+
+jobs:
+  pi-response:
+    # @pi requests, /answer replies, and edits of pi's questions (not other edited comments). Never events
+    # from a bot: with an App token, pi's own comments and edits would otherwise start new runs.
+    if: >-
+      github.event.sender.type != 'Bot'
+      && ((github.event.action == 'edited' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- pi-action:question'))
+      || (github.event.action != 'edited' && (contains(github.event.comment.body || github.event.issue.body || github.event.pull_request.body || '', '@pi')
+      || contains(github.event.comment.body || '', '/answer'))))
+    # Job-level, so runs the `if` skips never take the thread's single pending slot from a real one.
+    concurrency:
+      group: pi-action-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
+      cancel-in-progress: false
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Mint a GitHub App token
+        id: app
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
+        with:
+          client-id: ${{ vars.PI_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.PI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-contents: write
+          permission-issues: write
+          permission-pull-requests: write
+          permission-discussions: write
+          permission-actions: read
+          permission-checks: read
+          permission-statuses: read
+
+      - name: Commit as the App's bot user
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          SLUG: ${{ steps.app.outputs.app-slug }}
+        run: |
+          id=$(gh api "/users/${SLUG}%5Bbot%5D" --jq .id)
+          {
+            echo "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=${SLUG}[bot]"
+            echo "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=${SLUG}[bot]"
+            echo "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+            echo "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }} # pushes (branches, tags, refs/pi/threads/*) as the App
+          fetch-depth: 0 # tags and history, for release notes and version bumps
+
+      - name: Run pi-action
+        uses: cv/pi-action@9a1ef5509660c68074ade266675f4290de5df3a9 # v2.2.0
+        with:
+          github_token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
+          provider: nvidia
+          model: aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5
+          api_key: ${{ secrets.NVIDIA_API_KEY }}
+          provider_base_url: https://inference-api.nvidia.com
+          provider_api: anthropic-messages
+          model_name: Opus 5.5
+          model_reasoning: true
+          model_input: text,image
+          model_context_window: 1050000
+          model_max_tokens: 128000 # Bedrock's maximum for Opus 5.5
+          compat_force_adaptive_thinking: true
+          # A released pit, not this checkout: pi edits the checkout, and its tools shouldn't change under it.
+          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.0

```
